item.title: Suspicious factors for traffic stop in high-crime area didn’t quite add up
item.description: A recent 7th Circuit decision highlights that protective searches are evaluated based on the totality of the circumstances, not a single suspicious action.

item.title: Is the 'law enforcement family' mindset hurting accountability?
item.description: The phrase is meant to build loyalty and camaraderie. But when “family” culture blurs professional boundaries, police leaders may need to rethink the metaphor

item.title: NYPD probing possible 'ISIS-inspired terrorism' after IEDs thrown at protest near mayor’s residence
item.description: An individual in a crowd of counterprotesters threw two devices at protesters participating in a “Stop the Islamic Takeover of New York City” event

item.title: Shots Fired podcast: NYPD's quick response to IEDs thrown outside Mayor Mamdani's residence
item.description: The Shots Fired hosts analyze the rapid NYPD response and the broader security concerns raised by the demonstration outside Gracie Mansion

item.title: 'I got you, buddy': BWC shows San Antonio cop pull wounded colleague to safety during shootout
item.description: During a 2025 shootout that wounded seven officers, Officer Matthew Medina moved his wounded friend and colleague to shelter, helped render aid and drove him to the hospital

item.title: Pa. trooper shot, killed during traffic stop
item.description: Cpl. Timothy O'Connor was pulling a man over for erratic driving; as O'Connor approached the driver's side door, the driver fired shots, fatally wounding him

item.title: BWC: Man wielding machete, wearing ballistic armor runs at Md. officer before fatal OIS
item.description: Body camera footage shows the man approaching Charles County Sheriff's deputies and pulling a large knife from his clothing; two officers fired shots, fatally wounding the man
